messages: Subject: Evaluation sprint blueprint + MAP seed for Lumenix

Anna — following our call this morning, attached are two seeds to start the joint plan: (1) a MAP template populated with our recommended milestones and stakeholder owners, and (2) a short slides packet that outlines a 45‑day evaluation sprint we think will surface the key ROI signals for Lumenix.

High level asks:
- Can you confirm internal stakeholders who will own acceptance criteria (data, latency, privacy)?
- Do the milestones line up with your procurement timeline (you mentioned a 6‑week review window)?
- Can we schedule a 60‑minute workshop next Tue to lock owners and tech contacts?

I attached: Lumenix_MAP_template_v1.gdoc and 45d-eval-sprint-slides_v1.gslides (stubs). I left comment placeholders in the doc where we need your input on SLAs and data retention.

If helpful, Marissa and Stephanie are on standby to run the workshop and sketch the runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

—Michael

Thanks Michael — appreciate the quick turnaround and the structure. A few quick notes after skimming the MAP doc:
- We like the 4 major checkpoints but would prefer the acceptance criteria be split into technical and business KPIs (success = >2x query throughput at 95th percentile latency, and demoable accuracy > 88% on our labeled set).
- Procurement needs an explicit signoff step before week 5 — can that be added?
- We have a hard dependency on our data‑ingress policy; our security lead (Ben) is looped and will need the data flow diagram and KMS details.

I can do the workshop next Tue at 10 AM PT if that works for your team. Also, can Marissa highlight any optional quantization/hosting configurations (we may want Dedicated vs Hosted options called out)?

Ben — can you confirm whether we should send the SOC2 documentation now or wait until after the workshop?

Best,
Anna
